title: Cause-value diagnostics on compact monitoring frames
target_operation: Unknown Type Identification and Unknown Cause of Transmission
purpose: Exercise documented diagnostic cause values 44 and 45 using compact valid monitoring-type envelopes so parsers and dispatch tables see explicit unknown-type and unknown-cause indications.
expected_behavior: The endpoint should parse both frames as valid M_SP_NA_1 envelopes and branch on the documented diagnostic cause values 44 and 45.
constraints_preserved: Type_id 1 is a documented monitoring type
Cause values 44 and 45 are explicitly documented
Each frame keeps the same self-consistent 104 envelope
Two-byte common address and three-byte information object address are present
No unsupported service-specific payload is added
issue_safety_notes: These are standards-derived diagnostic cause-value seeds, not issue or crash analogues.
